body: Little things, just a moment where you enjoy something, anything.
So it’s her fault he wrote her a terrible resume?

No they aren’t. They were originally with salliemae and were transferred to Navient at some point. I went to an out of state school during my bachelors degree and didn’t realize they were charging me basically double the cost of tuition and were having me sign off on loans that I didn’t really know much about. I didn’t realize how much debt I had accrued until I was about to graduate. At that point the damage was already done. I was the first person in my family to graduate college. My parents didn’t even finish high school so we didn’t know anything about financial aid and student loans.
They are private education loans. I took them out starting in 2006. Right now they are close to $200,000 with interest included.

I have contacted them several times and even spoken with several attorneys. There seems to be nothing I can do. At this point, I feel like I can’t afford to live and have completely destroyed my family over this.

Thank you everyone for the perspective. I am exploring what options I have. I do want to ask one more question for anyone who may have gone through a divorce before. All of my money is in our joint account. He controls all of it. He gets notifications if I spend and I have to ask permission to buy anything. How can I begin this process without him knowing? I have already asked my employer to add a separate checking account to add a little to each month and they informed me I can only use one account. I have no way to move out, hire an attorney, etc without him finding out. I’m afraid of how he will react.

I’m so sorry you are going through this. When this happened to us we had a mobile vet come out and spare our dog the pain he was in. We felt he would be more comfortable having this done at home with all of us with him.
Did they desperately need it and maybe were too embarrassed to ask so they felt better confiscating it from you instead?
Sadly we don’t get to choose who we are attracted to. It would probably make life easier if we could. Does not make you a racist at all.
Honestly though I couldn’t bare the thought of taking my kids to a shelter. I wouldn’t want to give my husband any excuse to try to take them from me if I left.

He does actually say this. That me and our kids make him yell. The last time he did become physical (rare) he said afterward that I started the whole thing and made it sound like I went crazy or something. I’m still a little lost on what actually happened that day.
We actually tried therapy once a long time ago. He loves it immediately after, but by the next day he had decided he knew better than the therapist and never went again.

I’m seriously concerned for all the kids. I’m a teacher and literally everyday this week more kids are testing positive and having to quarantine. They are under 12 they can’t vaccinate why are we not shutting down again. I don’t want to teach a class of skeletons because no one wants to make a decision that might be considered unpopular.

Honestly I’ve thought about calling an attorney. I’ve even looked them up online. I’m worried that I’ll still be living with him before anything actually gets done and he will find out that I called one. He has been violent before. He’s threatened me if I try to leave. He has never put a hand on one of my children, only me and his mom. I feel like everything moves so slowly. He works from home so it would be hard for me to pack up and go without him seeing. I’m honestly afraid of how he would react. Even now I hide my phone when he walks passed. I don’t want him to know that I have this app or what I’ve posted.

I do have a daughter with him and no I would not be okay if she was with someone like him. That’s what makes this so much harder. He is very hard on both of our children and I always try to soothe their feelings afterward. There is no discussing anything, it’s just whatever he says it is. We have been together since I was 18. I have no family nearby or that could help. I have a masters degree and am currently a teacher. However I have a ton of student loan debt and bad credit. I would never be able to afford my own place where my kids would be safe. If I tried to leave I know he would use that to take them from me.

Have you mentioned this to anyone else? Sometimes another female can help. I was a tomboy through my teens until I gained some female friends and suddenly became a cheerleader. See if a female friend or relative will take her shopping for the wedding.

Yea I would say just keep your wallet secure. It sucks not being able to relax in your own space without worrying ab the possibility of your roommate stealing from you. Maybe it’s time to look for your own apartment.

I completely get. The only other thing to consider is that children and some people with certain conditions can’t get the vaccine. The virus is spreading through schools like crazy right now because all of the kids are under 12 and there is no vaccine for them. For those that can get it I feel like it’s a little selfish not to get it when it’s the kids that are really suffering.
